Cc: Venue Operations <venue-ops@moscone.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo pod sightline risk + carrycase inventory and floorplan sign-off

Hi team,

Attached is the latest floorplan (floorplan_v3.pdf) for our demo pod in Hall B — booth A12 corner pod. A couple of asks so we can lock the cabling/rigging and confirm signage sizes with expo works: 

- Can Marissa/Tessa confirm the literature restock counts? I've included our forecast but want to be conservative for the first two days (see literature_inventory_RevB.csv).
- Venue ops: please confirm that the 8' backwall permission allows the two-level shelf we plan to mount; sightlines from the adjacent demo island (booth A11) are tight and we may need to drop shelf height by 6\".
- Linda (ExpoWorks): can you confirm cost delta if we reduce the branded shelf to 4' high vs 5' high and whether you can deliver pre-mounted signage to expedite install?

Key constraints: 10ft aisle on our right (high traffic), power drop is at the rear center (marked on the plan). We'll need a short 2-day crate escort for the demo laptops and carrycases — list is in the CSV.

Please reply by EOD Tuesday so we can issue the PO and sign-off on the final print files.

Attachments: floorplan_v3.pdf (PDF, 1.3MB); literature_inventory_RevB.csv (CSV, 45KB)

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

Diego — thanks for the plan. Forwarding a few quick notes from ops and our production team (inline).

On Sun, Jul 25, 2027 at 9:12 AM Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.example> wrote:
> Attached is the latest floorplan (floorplan_v3.pdf) for our demo pod in Hall B — booth A12 corner pod. A couple of asks so we can lock the cabling/rigging and confirm signage sizes with expo works: 
> 
> - Can Marissa/Tessa confirm the literature restock counts? I've included our forecast but want to be conservative for the first two days (see literature_inventory_RevB.csv).
> - Venue ops: please confirm that the 8' backwall permission allows the two-level shelf we plan to mount; sightlines from the adjacent demo island (booth A11) are tight and we may need to drop shelf height by 6".
> - Linda (ExpoWorks): can you confirm cost delta if we reduce the branded shelf to 4' high vs 5' high and whether you can deliver pre-mounted signage to expedite install?
> 
> Key constraints: 10ft aisle on our right (high traffic), power drop is at the rear center (marked on the plan). We'll need a short 2-day crate escort for the demo laptops and carrycases — list is in the CSV.

Reply from ExpoWorks / Venue Ops: 
- Venue: the 8' max backwall is confirmed but no permanent fixtures above 8'. A two-level shelf is allowed if top shelf stays <= 8' and is secured. The sightline concern is valid — recommend changing the top shelf depth to 8" and lowering by 6" for sightlines.
- ExpoWorks production: switching the branded shelf from 5' to 4' reduces material + labor by $150 and trims install time ~20 minutes. Pre-mounted signage (printed and attached to the shelf frame) is doable — additional handling fee of $85; we can deliver to your booth by 8am move-in.
- Crate escort: we can handle a two-day escort; standard rate included in the PO.

Attachments: signage_mockups_v2.png (PNG, 870KB); expo_quote_789.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

Next steps: if you want us to produce at 4' and pre-mount, we'll update the PO and send DocuSign. Confirm here and we'll lock schedule.

Best,
Linda Park
Account Manager, ExpoWorks
linda@expoworks.com | +1 503-555-0199

Diego / Linda — quick answers from my side.

- Literature counts: please adjust the initial restock to 400 brochures, 250 one-sheets, and 60 whitepapers. The CSV looked fine but bump brochures by +100 for demo handouts day 1.
- Agree on lowering the top shelf by 6" for sightlines; the shallower top shelf (8") sounds safer.
- Pre-mounting signage: yes please — saves 30–45 minutes during install which helps our crew. Approve the $85 handling fee.

Can we also schedule a 30-minute site walk with ExpoWorks on move-in morning at 7:30am? I want to confirm power tap routing and the crate escort path. Linda — can you confirm you or one of your crew can meet then?

Thanks,
